Question Choices: Fill:Three objects are shown on an inch ruler: a crayon, a pencil, and an eraser. The crayon is ____ inches long. The pencil is ____ inches long. The eraser is ____ inches long. What is the total length of all three objects together? ____ inches
Solution: Read each object from the zero mark: crayon 3 inches, pencil 5 inches, eraser 2 inches. Add: 3+5+2 = 10 inches. Fill the blanks with 3, 5, 2, 10.

Question Choices: Select.A pencil is measured as 8 small paperclips long AND 16 centimeters long. Which unit of measure is longer?: ~~One-paperclip | One-centimeter~~
Solution: The same pencil needs 8 paperclips but 16 centimeters to cover its length. Fewer units cover the same distance only when each unit is longer. One paperclip is longer; it equals 2 centimeters here.

Question Choices: Select.A book is measured as 20 small paperclips long AND 15 centimeters long.Which unit of measure is longer?: ~~One-paperclip | One-centimeter~~
Solution: The same book needs 20 paperclips but only 15 centimeters. The smaller count uses the longer unit. One centimeter is longer than one of these paperclips.

Question Choices: Select.A book is measured as 4 jumbo paperclips long AND 10 centimeters long. Which unit of measure is longer?: ~~One-jumbo-paperclip | One-centimeter~~
Solution: The same book needs 4 jumbo paperclips but 10 centimeters. Fewer jumbo paperclips cover the same distance, so one jumbo paperclip is longer.

Question Choices: Select.The length of a rectangle is measured as 10 small paperclips long AND 8 centimeters long. Which unit of measure is longer?: ~~One-paperclip | One-centimeter~~
